### Gemini Agent Micro-SaaS Starter Kit

A production-ready template for building and monetizing AI apps using Next.js 14 App Router, Google Gemini 3.8 Flash API, and Stripe Checkout.

#### 1. Install Dependencies

npm install

#### 2. Environment Configuration (.env.local)

GEMINI_API_KEY=your_key_here STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_live_... NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=pk_live_... STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_...

#### 3. Run Locally & Deploy

npm run dev

Open http://localhost:3000 for landing page or /dashboard for the interactive playground. Ready for 1-click Vercel deployment.

### Gemini 3.8 Flash B2B Document & Invoice Extractor

Autonomous multimodal parser that extracts invoice numbers, dates, line items, VAT, and IBAN into validated Pydantic JSON with zero external OCR engines.

#### 1. Install Requirements

pip install -r requirements.txt

#### 2. Run via CLI or Web UI

# CLI execution: python parser.py sample_invoice.pdf # Start drag-and-drop web UI: python app.py

Open http://localhost:8000 to drag and drop PDF and image invoices directly in your browser.
